## Scientific/formal voice

An Assistance Permission Matrix is a versioned, participant-visible mapping from session, phase, tool or help category and research arm to a proposed or authorized allowance, required disclosure, accessibility exception and handling route, pinned to an Administration Policy before case exposure.

### Notation

No notation is required.

### Boundary conditions

- A matrix proposal is not an active rule until its owner issues the policy and the participant sees the exact version.
- A browser event or transcript style does not prove a prohibited resource was used; accessibility aids and approved research-arm allowances must remain distinct.
